query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS civilizational_markers (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  plant_id INT NOT NULL,
  civilization VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  period VARCHAR(255),
  start_year INT,
  end_year INT,
  usage_type ENUM('ritual','medical','commercial','funerary','cosmetic') NOT NULL,
  historical_significance TEXT,
  trade_routes JSON,
  archaeological_evidence TEXT,
  primary_sources JSON,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX civilizational_markers_plant_idx (plant_id),
  INDEX civilizational_markers_civilization_idx (civilization),
  INDEX civilizational_markers_period_idx (period),
  INDEX civilizational_markers_usage_idx (usage_type),
  CONSTRAINT chk_years CHECK ((start_year IS NULL OR end_year IS NULL) OR (start_year <= end_year))
);
